liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **East Virginia Blues**: back after 261 archived shows (1618 days); rare: 8 archived performances [8]
- **Train 45 snippet**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Cold Virginia Night**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **She Left Me Standing on the Mountain**: rare: 3 archived performances [8]
- **Hide and Seek reprise**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2026-04-18.aud.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 136 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Clean audience recording with very little crowd noise; Solid-sounding recording, so microphone placement is less of a worry than usual [4][6]
- **billystrings2026-04-18.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 136 min [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the stereo image is perfect [7]
- **billystrings2026-04-18.flac24**: source not stated; 24 songs; 136 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer calls this the show where Billy broke his leg [7]
- Reportedly Billy broke his leg backstage on a skateboard trick after set two, so there was no encore [1]
- The previous night had a special solo Billy stretch with no set break, which this show lacks [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2026-04-18.aud.flac16**: taped by tunegrabber; transferred by Zappafan2; source: FOB Sennheiser MKE2's>Marantz PMD620 [1]. Also: Taped stealth from section 113, row P, with Sennheiser MKE II mics into a Marantz PMD620, then Audacity at 24/48 to FLAC [1]
- **billystrings2026-04-18.flac16**: taped by Todd (titotito at gmail); transferred by Todd (titotito at gmail); source: Schoeps mk41 > kcy > RiotBox >> Sound Devices MixPre6 (24/48) [2]
- **billystrings2026-04-18.flac24**: taped by Todd (titotito at gmail); transferred by Todd (titotito at gmail); source: Schoeps mk41 > kcy > RiotBox >> Sound Devices MixPre6 (24/48) [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Blaxteeco: [Billy Strings Charlottesville Virginia 2026 Night 1 And 2 Combined Gig Poster At John Paul Jones Arena On April 17 And 1](https://blaxteeco.com/product/billy-strings-charlottesville-virginia-2026-night-1-and-2-combined-gig-poster-at-john-paul-jones-arena-on-april-17-and-18-2026-the-eye-art-poster-canvas/) [9]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings John Paul Jones Arena 2026 - N1 Poster Regular - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/john-paul-jones-arena-2026-n1-poster-regular/) [10]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings John Paul Jones Arena 2026 - N1 Poster Regular - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/john-paul-jones-arena-2026-n1-poster-regular/) [11]
- Fan art by theultimateconcertteeshop.com: [Billy Strings Apr 18 2026 The John Paul Jones Arena Charlottesville VA Tour Poster -](https://theultimateconcertteeshop.com/product/billy-strings-apr-18-2026-the-john-paul-jones-arena-charlottesville-va-tour-poster/) [12]
- Poster by Musicdope80s.com: [Billy Strings The John Paul Jones Arena Apr 18 2026 Concert Poster Canvas](https://musicdope80s.com/billy-strings-the-john-paul-jones-arena-apr-18-2026-concert-poster-canvas/) [13]
